Sandbox_EAU_Enabled_tooltip: When enabled, newly looted items in the selected groups are marked Unwanted for the player who transferred them.
Sandbox_EAU_Clothing_tooltip: Includes Organized Categories clothing, footwear, gloves, protection, undergarments, and clothing accessories.
Sandbox_EAU_Tools_tooltip: Includes all active Build 42 Organized Categories Tool groups, including mechanics, carpentry, construction, cooking, electrical, farming, fishing, medical, metalworking, survival, and crafting-specialty tools.
Sandbox_EAU_Firearms_tooltip: Includes every Organized Categories firearm caliber. Ammunition and non-firearm weapons are not included.
Sandbox_EAU_Books_tooltip: Includes Organized Categories skill books, recipe literature, entertainment books or magazines, and Literature - Writeable items. Maps and stationery tools are not included.
Sandbox_EAU_Artifacts_tooltip: Includes items using the Artifact display category.
Sandbox_EAU_CookingUtensils_tooltip: Includes items using Organized Categories' Cooking - Utensil category.
